_note: Recorded in Snowflake SQL API encoding (every cell a string or null; DATE = days since 1970-01-01; FIXED = integer string). Columns follow the official Unity Analytics Data Access view reference. Synthetic values; not a real account. Tests inject a fixed clock of 2026-09-21T09:00:00Z (window 2026-09-07..2026-09-20, report date 2026-09-20).

schema._note: Source-side columns of the two views this slice queries, per the official view reference (docs.unity.com/en-us/analytics/data-access/data-access-views). The schema compile test resolves every identifier and binding of the generated statements against it. ACCOUNT_USERS has START_DATE, not PLAYER_START_DATE; PLAYER_START_DATE exists only in ACCOUNT_EVENTS and the fact views.

account_games._note: Response to ACCOUNT_GAMES WHERE GAME_NAME = 'QA2': one row per environment.

new_users_by_start_date._note: Response to the ACCOUNT_USERS aggregate for GAME_ID 24601, ENVIRONMENT_ID 31001, [2026-09-07, 2026-09-21). The date column is named START_DATE because the statement selects ACCOUNT_USERS.START_DATE with no alias. 2026-09-13 (20709) has no row on purpose.
